title: [YSQL] BNL with a mix of equality and non-equality filters returns incorrect results
body:
Jira Link: [DB-9535](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-9535)
### Description

Consider the following setup on 2.20.1.0
```
create table ss1 (a int, b int);
create table ss2(a int, b int);
create table ss3(a int, b int);
create index on ss3(a asc);
insert into ss1 values (1,1), (1,2);
insert into ss2 values (1,1), (1,2);
insert into ss3 values (1,1), (1,3);
explain analyze /*+Set(enable_hashjoin off)
Set(enable_material off)
Set(enable_mergejoin off)
Set(yb_bnl_batch_size 1024)
NestLoop(ss1 ss2) Rows(ss1 ss2 #1024)*/select * from ss1,ss2, ss3 p where ss1.a = ss2.a and ss1.b = ss2.b and p.b <= ss2.b + 1 and p.a = ss1.a;

                                                       QUERY PLAN                                                       
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 YB Batched Nested Loop Join  (cost=0.00..115105.38 rows=1707 width=24) (actual time=3.533..3.540 rows=2 loops=1)
   Join Filter: ((ss1.a = p.a) AND (p.b <= (ss2.b + 1)))
   Rows Removed by Join Filter: 1
   ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.00..115100.00 rows=1024 width=16) (actual time=1.365..2.478 rows=2 loops=1)
         Join Filter: ((ss1.a = ss2.a) AND (ss1.b = ss2.b))
         Rows Removed by Join Filter: 2
         ->  Seq Scan on ss1  (cost=0.00..100.00 rows=1000 width=8) (actual time=0.790..0.793 rows=2 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on ss2  (cost=0.00..100.00 rows=1000 width=8) (actual time=0.497..0.829 rows=2 loops=2)
   ->  Index Scan using ss3_a_idx on ss3 p  (cost=0.00..5.20 rows=10 width=8) (actual time=0.973..0.977 rows=2 loops=1)
         Index Cond: (a = ANY (ARRAY[ss1.a, $1, $2, ..., $1023]))
 Planning Time: 0.526 ms
 Execution Time: 3.818 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 476 kB
(13 rows)

/*+Set(enable_hashjoin off)
Set(enable_material off)
Set(enable_mergejoin off)
Set(yb_bnl_batch_size 1024)
NestLoop(ss1 ss2) Rows(ss1 ss2 #1024)*/select * from ss1,ss2, ss3 p where ss1.a = ss2.a and ss1.b = ss2.b and p.b <= ss2.b + 1 and p.a = ss1.a;
 a | b | a | b | a | b 
---+---+---+---+---+---
 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1
 1 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1
(2 rows)

However, if we turn BNL off we get
/*+Set(enable_hashjoin off)
Set(enable_material off)
Set(enable_mergejoin off)
Set(yb_bnl_batch_size 1)
NestLoop(ss1 ss2) Rows(ss1 ss2 #1024)*/select * from ss1,ss2, ss3 p where ss1.a = ss2.a and ss1.b = ss2.b and p.b <= ss2.b+1 and p.a = ss1.a;
 a | b | a | b | a | b 
---+---+---+---+---+---
 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1
 1 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 3
 1 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1
(3 rows)
```

This issue seems to be on master too.

kind/bug
